description: Birdhouses, laundry, indoor exercise, a countryside picnic, a washing machine and a leaking roof give Pat and Mat a run of everyday jobs where convenience is repeatedly replaced by machinery, rearrangement and stubborn experimentation.

s03e01.description: Birdsong inspires Pat and Mat to build a birdhouse. When their carefully made home fails to attract a tenant, they start modifying the plan to make it more appealing.

s03e02.description: A routine laundry day expands dramatically as Pat and Mat discover that once the washing apparatus is ready, there are plenty of other things around the house that might also benefit from a wash.

s03e03.description: When the television fails during a sports broadcast, Pat and Mat decide to exercise instead, recreating a whole range of sporting activities inside the house with predictably unsuitable equipment.

s03e04.description: Pat and Mat head into the countryside for breakfast on the grass, then keep adding comforts until their supposedly outdoor picnic begins to resemble a fully furnished living room.

s03e05.description: A new washing machine has to be carried upstairs, connected and persuaded to work. By the time Pat and Mat finish engineering the setup, washing clothes is no longer the obvious use for it.

s03e06.description: Rain pours into the country house through multiple leaks, forcing Pat and Mat onto the roof where every attempt to stop the water creates a new challenge in keeping the weather outside.
